Per-sign transliteration derived mechanically from Unicode; word-level romanization auto-generated (schwa-reduced) and approximate. Transliteration convention: ś = ሠ-series, ʿ = ዐ-series, ə = 6th order, 1st order ä, 4th order a. Translations made fresh from the Geʿez; Dillmann's Lexicon (1865) the lexical aid.
about: Chapter 73 gives Adrami's first judgment in the sheep-and-vineyard case; Baltasar, amazed, names him his heir, and Adrami becomes king of Rome, the world's kingship having been given to Shem's seed. Chapter 74 turns to the king of Midian and traces the line of Esau and Edom, using Esau's lost birthright to preach that the soul must bind the flesh, with sayings of Paul and of Christ to his disciples. Chapter 75 begins the story of Karmin, a rich and pious man of Judah who settles in Armathaim and draws Satan's envy.

sentences.i: If the sheep uprooted the shoots of the vine-stock, roots and all, they are yours; and if they ate the foliage of the shoots and the blossom of the tendril, take the fleece of their wool and their young, those that have not yet borne a first-born (?);
sentences.n: ለእመ ‘if’ with the perfect ሠረዋ (ሠረወ ‘root out, uproot’, 3fp, the sheep as feminine plural); አሕሩገ ጒንዲ is a construct, ‘shoots (?) of the stock/trunk (?)’, and ሥረዎን ወኵሎን ‘their roots and all of them’ (-ን 3fp), ለከ ‘to you’, i.e. the animals become the vineyard owner's. The second ‘if’ has በልዓ ‘they (f.) ate’ (3fp, the same ending as ሠረዋ, so the same subject, the sheep; a 3ms ‘he ate’ would be በልዐ): ቈጽለ ‘foliage, leaves’, አዕጹቅ (?) a plural I take as ‘shoots’, ወጽጌ ቆዕ ‘and blossom of the tendril’ (?). This echoes the owner's plea in the previous part (‘it ate it only when the tendril had put forth blossom’). ንሣእ is the imperative of ነሥአ ‘take’; ቅርፅ ‘rind, outer covering’ is my best guess for the fleece (?). እለ ኢተበኵራ ‘those (f.) which have not borne a firstborn’ (ተበኵረ) is also uncertain (?). The verdict is a split by status of the ewes.

sentences.l: And-said Baltasar: in-truth this judgment is-judgment-of people-of God-of Israel; and-from-now-but for-whoever-also he-contends, judge; and-for-whoever-also he-fights, fight; and-for-whoever-also he-is-judged, condemn; and-for-whoever-also he-lives, give-life; and-for-all according-to his-judgment, judge; and-take this city for-you and-for-your-seed after-you.
sentences.i: And Baltasar said: In truth, this judgment is the judgment of the people of the God of Israel. From now on, for whoever contends, give judgment; for whoever goes to war, make war; for whoever is to be judged, pass sentence; for whoever is to live, grant life; and for everyone, judge according to his judgment (?). And take this city for yourself and for your seed after you.
sentences.n: Baltasar's response, built on a run of imperatives. በአማን ‘in truth’; ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል is a three-link chain, ‘judgment-of people-of God-of Israel’: he credits the verdict to the God of Israel, not to Adrami's wit. ወእምይእዜሰ ‘and from now on’. Each clause pairs ለዘሂ ‘for whoever’ with an imperfect and then an imperative of the same root: ይትዋቀሥ (ተዋቀሠ ‘dispute, contend’) ፍታሕ ‘judge’; ይፀብእ (ፀብአ ‘make war’) ፅባእ ‘fight’; ይትኴነን (ተኰነነ ‘be judged, condemned’) ኰንን ‘condemn’; የሐዩ ‘lives’ አሕዩ ‘give life’ (the causative of ሐይወ), a royal power of life and death. በከመ ፍትሑ ‘according to his judgment/right’ (?) could also mean ‘as he is judged’. ወንሥኣ is ንሣእ ‘take’ + -ኣ ‘her’ (3fs), ‘take it (the city)’. ለዘርእከ ‘for your seed’ and እምድኅሬከ ‘after you’. So Baltasar makes Adrami his heir. ሕዝብ ‘people’ is the Old Testament phrase for Israel; the whole speech reads as Adrami's kingship ratified.

sentences.i: And the city of Rome became Adrami's for all generations, since by the will of God the whole kingdom of the world was given to the seed of Shem, servitude to the seed of Ham, and ጒዕትያ (?) to the seed of Japheth.
sentences.n: ኮነት ‘it became’ (f.) agrees with ሀገረ. ለአድራሚ ‘to Adrami’, ለትውልደ ትውልዲ ‘for the generation of generation’, i.e. for all generations (ትውልዲ for ትውልድ is Bezold's spelling (?)). The reason (እስመ): the sons of Noah (Genesis 9–10) receive different lots, with Shem as bearer of kingship (a claim of the book). ተውህበ ‘was given’, passive of ወሀበ; መንግሥተ ዓለም ‘kingdom-of world’. ግብርናት is the abstract of ገብር ‘servant’: servitude, echoing Noah's curse on Ham's line (Genesis 9:25). ጒዕትያ is a word I cannot place (?); set against ‘kingship’ and ‘servitude’ it stands for some third portion. The row of ፨ marks the end of the chapter; the previous part ended the same way.

sentences.n: The story is Genesis 25:24–34: the twins, Jacob holding Esau's heel (ሰኰና, ‘heel’ here, normally ‘hoof’), and the birthright sold for lentil stew. ዘወፅአ ‘who came out’; እምከርሠ እሙ ‘from the womb of his mother’ (ከርሥ ‘belly, womb’); እንዘ ይእኅዞ ‘while he was holding him’. ሄደ ብኵርናቱ ለዔሳው ‘his birthright went, Esau’s’: ሄደ looks like the Amharic-type form of ‘went’ (beside ሖረ), with the birthright as subject and ለዔሳው marking possession, so ‘was lost’ by idiom (?). በእንተ ተብሲለ ብርስን ‘on account of the cooking of lentils’ (ተብሲል, a verbal noun, ‘being cooked’ (?)). ጽዕለቱ ‘his redness’ (?): the Bible links Edom (Hebrew ʾĔdom) with ‘red’, but this text glosses the name as ‘lentils’; ኤዶም ትርጒምናሁ ብርስን ብሂል ‘Edom, its interpretation, lentils, saying’ is an explanatory aside, ‘that is to say’. ትርጒምናሁ ‘its interpretation’ is an unusual suffixed form. glossary.ለዘሂ: ዘ — for whoever (ለ- + relative ዘ + indefinite -ሂ)
glossary.ለዘርአ: ዘርእ — to the seed of (ለ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ለዛቲ: ዛቲ — to this, of this (ለ- + fem. demonstrative ዛቲ before ትውልድ)
glossary.ለ፲ወ፪: ፲ወ፪ — numeral 12 — ለ- + numeral, before ነገደ · spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-kəlʾetu) 'twelve'
glossary.ላዕሌሁ: ላዕለ — upon, over (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form ላዕሌ-)
glossary.ላዕሌሆሙ: ላዕለ — upon them, over them (preposition + 3mp suffix)
glossary.ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel')
glossary.ሖረ: ሖረ — he went (3m sg perfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ሖሩ: ሖረ — they went (3mp perfect, ḥ-w-r) · go! (2mp imperative, ሖሩ በመንፈስ 'go in the spirit')
glossary.መንግሥተ: መንግሥት — kingdom (construct 'kingdom of') · also the plain accusative 'a kingdom' (ዘይነፍቅ መንግሥተ 'who would seize a kingdom')
glossary.መኳንንተ: መኰንን — princes, nobles (plural መኳንንት, construct 'princes of') · accusative 'princes' as object of ይፈርህ (ወይፈርህ መኳንንተ 'and he fears the princes')
glossary.ሙ: ሙ — -ሙ, detached pronominal suffix; it completes the preceding እምኔክ as እምኔክሙ 'from you (pl.)' (suffix, 2mp) · here completing አባሕኩክ as አባሕኩክሙ 'I … you (pl.)' (suffix -ሙ, 2mp, split from its word by the wordspace)
glossary.ምዉታነ: ምዉት — the dead (adjective used as noun, plural ምዉታን, accusative)
glossary.ምድያም: ምድያም — Midian (proper name; ንጉሠ ምድያም 'king of Midian')
glossary.ምድያምሂ: ምድያም — Midian also (proper name + enclitic -ሂ 'also, indeed')
glossary.ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
glossary.ሠረዋ: ሠረወ — they (f.) uprooted (3fp perfect, G, ś-r-w)
glossary.ሠናያት: ሠናይ — good things (adjective used as noun, f. plural ሠናያት)
glossary.ሠናይ: ሠናይ — good, beautiful (adj.) · 'good' as a substantive (ዘይረክበከ ሠናይ 'what good will find you')
glossary.ሤም: ሴም — Shem (proper name; spelled ሤም here)
glossary.ሥሥዕት: ሥሥዕት — loosened, unrestrained (?) (word not securely parsed; counterpart of እስርት) (?)
glossary.ሥረዎን: ሥር — their roots (noun, plural ሥረው + -ን '3fp their')
glossary.ሥጋሰ: ሥጋ — flesh, for its part (noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ርትዕት: ርትዕ — straight, upright, right (adjective, f. sg. ርትዕት, agreeing with ፍኖት)
glossary.ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
glossary.ስምዑኒ: ሰምዐ — hear me! (G 2mp imperative with suffix 1cs -ኒ)
glossary.ቅርፅ: ቅርፅ — rind, outer covering; here the fleece (?) (noun, construct 'fleece of') (?)
glossary.ቆዕ: ቆዕ — unknown word, meaning not established (?) · here (ወጽጌ ቆዕ) tentatively 'tendril' from the sense (?)
glossary.በልዓ: በልዐ — they (f.) ate (3fp perfect, G, b-l-ʿ) (?) · or he ate it (f.) (3ms perfect + -ā '3fs it') (?)
glossary.በልጣሶር: በልጣሶር — Baltasor (proper name; a king of Rome in this story, name as printed)
glossary.በመንግሥተ: መንግሥት — in the kingdom of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በመንግሥትየ: መንግሥት — in my kingdom (በ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.በመንፈስ: መንፈስ — by the spirit (በ- 'by, in' + noun; በመንፈስ ቅዱስ 'by the Holy Spirit')
glossary.በሰኰናሁ: ሰኰና — by his heel (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; normally 'hoof')
glossary.በስጥመተ: ስጥመት — through the plunging, absorption of (?) (በ- + verbal noun, construct; from ሰጠመ 'sink') (?)
glossary.በቅለ: በቅል — mule (accusative, predicate of ኮነ); the same word stands beside አድግ/ዓድግ 'ass' elsewhere in the text · or 'herbage, grass' (በቅል; በቅለ ንጉሥ 'the king's herbage', accusative) (?)
glossary.በአማን: አማን — truth; በአማን 'in truth, truly' (በ- + noun)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that') · at that which, because of what (ሰምዐት በዘ ነገራ 'she heard at what he told her') · whereby, with which, purpose clause (በዘ ይኴንን ሕዝቦ 'that with which he may rule his people') · 'since' of time (ዮም ተሱዕ መዋዕል በዘ ኀለፉ 'it is nine days since they passed')
glossary.በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.በፈቃዶሙ: ፈቃድ — by their will (በ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
glossary.በፍኖት: ፍኖት — on the road, in the way (በ- + noun, fem.)
glossary.ባቢሎን: ባቢሎን — Babylon (proper name; ንጉሠ ባቢሎን 'king of Babylon')
glossary.ብሂል: ብሂል — saying, meaning, 'that is' (verbal noun of ብህለ)
glossary.ብኵርናቱ: ብኵርና — his birthright (noun, stem ብኵርናት + -ሁ '3ms his') (?)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
glossary.ቦ: ቦ — there is to him, he has (በ- + -ኦ 'him'; existential)
glossary.ተመሰልክሙ: ተመሰለ — you (pl.) were made like, likened (2mp perfect, tä-stem, m-s-l)
glossary.ተሰምየ: ተሰምየ — he was named, called (3ms perfect passive of ሰመየ)
glossary.ተሰምዩ: ሰምየ — they were called (passive ተሰምየ, 3mp perfect)
glossary.ተበኵራ: ተበኵረ — they bore a firstborn (3fp perfect (?), from በኵር 'firstborn') (?)
glossary.ተብሲለ: ተብሲል — cooking, being cooked (?) (verbal noun, from ብሰለ 'be cooked'; construct 'cooking of') (?)
glossary.ተውህበ: ወሀበ — it was given (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive)
glossary.ታንሥኡ: አንሥአ — you (pl.) raise (2mp imperfect/subjunctive, causative, ʾ-n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ታዐብይዎሙ: አዐበየ — you (pl.) will exalt them (2mp imperfect, causative of ዐበየ + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ትርጒምናሁ: ትርጒም — its interpretation (noun + unusual suffix -ናሁ '3ms its') (?)
glossary.ትኴንንዎሙ: ኰነነ — you (pl.) will judge, condemn them (2mp imperfect + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ትውልዲ: ትውልድ — generation (noun; Bezold's spelling ትውልዲ in ለትውልደ ትውልዲ) (?)
glossary.ትፈውሱ: ፈወሰ — you (pl.) heal (2mp imperfect/subjunctive, G, f-w-s)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ኀደገ: ኀደገ — he left, gave up (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኀደጉ: ኀደገ — they left (3mp perfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኀደግነ: ኀደገ — we left, abandoned (1cp perfect, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ኅድግ: ኀደገ — leave! (2ms imperative, G, ḫ-d-g; Bezold's spelling ኅድግ)
glossary.ነገደ: ነገድ — tribe, clan (noun; construct 'tribes of', accusative)
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አሕሩገ: አሕሩግ — shoots (?) (noun, plural, construct 'shoots of'; meaning and singular not established) (?)
glossary.አሕዩ: አሕየወ — give life! (2ms imperative, causative of ሐይወ)
glossary.አመክዒቦ: አመክዒቦ — unknown word, read tentatively 'in full measure' (from ምክዕብ 'cube, a measure') (?) (?)
glossary.አሰረ: አሰረ — he bound (3ms perfect, G, ʾ-s-r)
glossary.አባሕኩክ: አባሐ — I permitted, authorised (?) (1cs perfect, ʾ-b-ḥ + -ክ(ሙ) '2mp you'; the suffix is completed by the next token ሙ, the whole word being አባሕኩክሙ) (?)
glossary.አውሥኦተ: አውሥኦት — answering, reply (verbal noun of አውሥአ, construct 'answering of'; accusative)
glossary.አግማለ: ገመል — camels (plural አግማል, accusative; object of ይጽዕን)
glossary.አጥብዐ: አጥብዐ — he strengthened, steadied (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, ṭ-b-ʿ; the base verb is not established) (?)
glossary.ኢተበኵራ: ተበኵረ — they (f.) had not borne a firstborn (ኢ- + 3fp perfect (?), from በኵር 'firstborn') (?)
glossary.ኢተአስረት: ተአሰረ — she was not bound (ኢ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem passive of አሰረ; subject ነፍስ)
glossary.ኢትግበሩ: ገብረ — do not do (ኢ- + 2mp jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምብኵርናተ: ብኵርና — from the birthright of (እም- + noun, stem ብኵርናት, construct) (?)
glossary.እምከርሠ: ከርሥ — from the womb of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስርት: አሰረ — bound (feminine adjective/participle, f. sg., of አሰረ 'bind') (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከርሡ: ከርሥ — his belly, his body (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ከርሥ: ከርሥ — belly, womb (noun; ፍትወተ ከርሥ 'the desire of the belly')
glossary.ክቡረ: ክቡር — precious, honoured (adjective, accusative, qualifying አልባሰ)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine')
glossary.ኰንን: ኰነነ — judge! condemn! (2ms imperative, G, k-w-n-n)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወሀሎ: ሀሎ — and he was, he lived (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, h-l-w)
glossary.ወሄደ: ሖረ — and it went, was lost (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ሄደ an Amharic-type form for ሖረ; subject ብኵርናቱ) (?)
glossary.ወለእለሰ: እለ — and as for those who (ወ- + ለ- + plural relative + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
glossary.ወለኵሉ: ኵሉ — and to all, for all (ወ- + ለ- + ኵሉ)
glossary.ወለዘሂ: ዘ — and for whoever (ወ- + ለ- + relative ዘ + indefinite -ሂ)
glossary.ወለዘርእከ: ዘርእ — and to your seed (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወመራዕየ: መርዔት — and pastures of (ወ- + plural መራዕይ of መርዔት, construct, accusative) · here 'herds of' (ወመራዕየ እንስሳ 'and herds of livestock')
glossary.ወሠምሩ: ሠምረ — and they consented, were pleased (root ś-m-r)
glossary.ወሰይጣንሰ: ሰይጣን — and Satan, for his part (ወ- + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወሶበሂ: ሶበ — and when also (ወ- + conjunction + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወበስመ: ስም — and by the name of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበእንተዝኬ: በእንተዝ — and therefore, for this reason (ወ- + በእንተ + ዝ 'this' + -ኬ)
glossary.ወበኵሉ: ኵሉ — and in all, in every (ወ- + በ- + quantifier)
glossary.ወበዳግም: ዳግም — and at the second (ወ- + በ- + adjective 'second'; ዳግም ምጽአት 'second coming')
glossary.ወበፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — and by the will of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.ወተለውናከ: ተለወ — and we followed you (ወ- + 1cp perfect + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወተስዕረ: ተሰዕረ — and he was defeated, cast out (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ሰዐረ) (?)
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወታስተኀፍርዎሙ: አስተኀፈረ — and you (pl.) will shame them (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, astä-stem of ኀፈረ + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወታስተፌሥሕዎሙ: አስተፈሥሐ — and you (pl.) will make them rejoice (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, astä-stem causative of ፈሠሐ + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወትኪዲ: ከይደ — and you tread, trample (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, k-y-d; spelled ትኪዲ with the 2fs ending -i, for plural ትኪዱ) (?)
glossary.ወትገብሩ: ገብረ — and you (pl.) do (ወ- + 2mp imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወኀብረ: ኀብረ — and it joined (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G; subject ነጐድጓድ) · and he joined (ወ- + 3ms perfect, subject the man; ወኀብረ ምስለ ፍትወተ ነፍሱ 'and joined with the desire of his soul')
glossary.ወኀብረት: ኀብረ — and she joined (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G, ḫ-b-r; subject ነፍሱ)
glossary.ወነፍስሰ: ነፍስ — and the soul, for its part (ወ- + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንሥኣ: ነሥአ — and take her! (ወ- + 2ms imperative ንሣእ + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወንነግረክሙ: ነገረ — and we tell you (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, G, n-g-r + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወአልህምተ: ላህም — and oxen (ወ- + plural አልህምት, accusative)
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአርትዐ: አርትዐ — and he set right, put in order (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ርትዐ) (?)
glossary.ወአስተሐቀሩ: አስተሐቀረ — and they despised (ወ- + 3mp perfect, astä-stem, ḥ-q-r)
glossary.ወአኀዞ: አኀዘ — and he took hold of him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾ-ḫ-z, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአንበርዎ: አንበረ — and they made him settle (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነበረ + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአንከርዎ: አንከረ — and they marveled at him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative-type stem, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአንገሥዎ: አንገሠ — and they made him king (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነግሠ + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወአፍራሰ: ፈረስ — and horses (ወ- + plural አፍራስ, accusative)
glossary.ወኢምንተኒ: ምንት — and not anything, nothing (ወ- + ኢ- + 'what' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወእለሰ: እለ — and those who indeed (ወ- + relative pl. + ሰ 'indeed')
glossary.ወእምአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and from then, from that time (ወ- + እም- 'from' + adverb 'then')
glossary.ወእምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and from now on, indeed (ወ- + እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምድኅረዝ: ድኅረ — and after this (ወ- + እም- 'from' + ድኅረ 'after' + ዝ 'this')
glossary.ወእግዚእነሂ: እግዚእ — and our lord also (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1pl our' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወክልኤሆን: ክልኤ — and the two of them (ወ- + numeral 'two' + -ሆን '3fp them', f.)
glossary.ወኵሎን: ኵሉ — and all of them (ወ- + quantifier + -ን '3fp them', f.)
glossary.ወወሀብኩክሙ: ወሀበ — and I gave you (ወ- + 1cs perfect, G, w-h-b + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወወለዳ: ወለደ — and they (f.) gave birth (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, w-l-d)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወዓሥራተሂ: ዓሥራት — and tithes also (ወ- + noun 'tenths, tithe' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘኢትፈቱ: ፈተወ — and what does not desire (ወ- + ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3fs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይሴሲ: ሴሰየ — and he tends, supplies with food (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect) (?)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይገብር: ገብረ — and he does, makes (ወ- + 3m sg imperfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ወይፈርህ: ፈርሀ — and he fears (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, f-r-ḥ)
glossary.ወደቂቆን: ደቂቅ — and their young (ወ- + noun, plural 'little ones, young' + -ን '3fp their')
glossary.ወግብርናት: ግብርናት — and servitude (ወ- + abstract noun from ገብር 'servant')
glossary.ወጒዕትያ: ጒዕትያ — and ጒዕትያ, unknown word, a third portion beside kingship and servitude (?) (ወ- + noun) (?)
glossary.ወጽጌ: ጽጌ — and blossom of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወፍትወተ: ፍትወት — and the desire of (ወ- + noun, construct; object of ኢትግበሩ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዘሥጋ: ሥጋ — of flesh (ዘ- + noun; 'the law of the flesh')
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘኢትፈቱ: ፈተወ — what does not desire (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3fs imperfect, G; subject ነፍስ/ሥጋ)
glossary.ዘኢአምኑ: አምነ — that they did not believe (ዘ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, G, ʾ-m-n; በእንተ ዘ- 'because')
glossary.ዘእፈትሕ: ፈትሐ — what I judge (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect, G, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘየሐውር: ሖረ — which goes, travels (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — what he wished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.የሐዩ: ሐይወ — he lives (3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-y-w)
glossary.የአምኑ: አምነ — they believe (3mp imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ያወርዶ: አውረደ — it brings him down (3ms imperfect, causative of ወረደ, w-r-d + -ኦ 'him'; subject ፍትወተ ከርሥ (?))
glossary.ይሁብ: ወሀበ — he gives (3ms imperfect, G, w-h-b)
glossary.ይልእኮ: ለአከ — he sends him (3ms imperfect, G, l-ʾ-k + -ኦ 'him'; habitual 'would send')
glossary.ይሠውዕ: ሠውዐ — he offers sacrifice (3ms imperfect, G, ś-w-ʿ)
glossary.ይቀንእ: ቀንአ — he envies (3ms imperfect, G, q-n-ʾ)
glossary.ይቤሉ: ብህለ — they said (3mp perfect ይቤሉ, b-h-l)
glossary.ይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — he said to them (3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ይትኣበያ: ተኣበየ — they (f.) oppose each other (3fp imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of አበየ)
glossary.ይትኴነን: ተኰነነ — he is judged, condemned (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ኰነነ)
glossary.ይትዋቀሥ: ተዋቀሠ — he contends, disputes (3ms imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal, w-q-ś)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ይንበር: ነበረ — he might dwell (3ms subjunctive, G, n-b-r; after ከመ)
glossary.ይእኅዞ: አኀዘ — he was holding him (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-ḫ-z + -ኦ 'him'; after እንዘ)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይፀብእ: ፀብአ — he makes war, fights (3ms imperfect, G, ṣ-b-ʾ)
glossary.ደወሉሰ: ደወል — his home region (?) (noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + contrastive -ሰ; the lexicon gives ደወል 'bell', the sense here is guessed) (?)
glossary.ድውያነ: ድዉይ — the sick (adjective used as noun, plural ድውያን, accusative)
glossary.ጒንዲ: ጒንድ — stock, trunk (noun; Bezold's spelling ጒንዲ)
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ጽዕለቱ: ጽዕለት — his redness (?) (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; meaning guessed) (?)
glossary.ፈራሄ: ፈራሂ — fearer of (noun, construct 'fearer of'; ፈራሄ እግዚኣብሔር 'fearer of God')
glossary.ፈፀንት: ፈፀንት — unknown word, subject of ወአኀዞ; perhaps an affliction or infirmity (?) (noun in -ት; meaning guessed from the sense) (?)
glossary.ፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — joy (construct 'joy of') · also the plain accusative 'joy' with an adjective (ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they joined in great joy')
glossary.ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
glossary.ፍኖቱ: ፍኖት — his road, way (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53)
glossary.፸፫: ፸፫ — numeral 73 — chapter number · spoken ሰብዓ ወሠለስቱ (säbʿa wä-śälästu) 'seventy-three'
glossary.፸፬: ፸፬ — numeral 74 — chapter number · spoken ሰብዓ ወአርባዕቱ (säbʿa wä-ʾärbaʿtu) 'seventy-four'
glossary.፸፭: ፸፭ — numeral 75 — chapter number · spoken ሰብዓ ወኀምስቱ (säbʿa wä-ḫäməstu) 'seventy-five'
